reviews.body: $70/yr for a Bible is crazy work. Unfortunately, there are advertisements everywhere: Multiple pop ups when logging in, ads when trying to use the app, ads at the beginning and end of everything you listen to. 

It’s incredibly distracting and really destroys the user experience.

the auto play at the beginning is also extremely frustrating and annoying, and hard to figure out how to stop.

This app has so much good content, but the user experience is so bad that I can’t continue with it.

Because of that, I’ve decided to stop using the app. I hope the developers consider keeping the content centered on spirituality and prayer for users seeking that experience.
